name: hEvo benchmarks
description: A suite of DNA genomic tasks covering sequence representation, regulatory prediction, variant-effect scoring, ancestry and evolutionary analysis, with evaluation workflows in the hEVO repository.

attributes.task: Sequence representations (NT tasks, Genomic Benchmark, URE); regulatory prediction (DeepSEA multi-label with LoRA); variant effects (ClinVar, candidate causal and rare variants, DDD, MPRA, retrospective reclassification); ancestry (population embeddings, classification, ancestry-proportion regression); evolution and adaptation (HAR/HAQER classification, adaptive-allele preference); training and efficiency ablations.
limitations: A positive LLR indicates a higher conditional likelihood for ALT; this is a model preference score, not a calibrated probability of pathogenicity.

name: hEvo
